 and Registrar's  order with  Signatures  WPCRL No.1185 of 2025  Hon'ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Mr. Vinod Sharma, learned counsel for the Petitioner.

2. Mr. Vipul Painuly, learned AGA for the State/respondent nos.1 & 2.
3.

Present writ petition has been filed by the petitioner under Article 226 of the Constitution of India for quashing the FIR No.0022 of 2025 under Section 376 & 506 of IPC dated 22.09.2025 Police Station Gopeshwar, District Chamoli.
4. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner makes a submission that present matter is purely based on the political rivalry and false contention that resulted in present FIR.

5. Learned counsel for the petitioner further submits that though as per FIR the allegations alleged to be made against the petitioner are that physical relation being committed on the pretext of false marriage whereas it is not so.
6. Learned counsel for the petitioner specifically denies the said allegation and submits that no physical relation had been committed by the petitioner with respondent no.3.
7.

8. Let the objection be filed by the State/respondent nos.1 & 2 within two weeks.
9.
List this matter on 13.10.2025 as fresh.

(Ashish Naithani, J.) 08.10.2025 Arti WPCRL/1185/2025 on 8 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/196759202/
